_readme: Books held at the number of published people without a LinkedIn or X link that they carried when the social-link floor landed (2026-10-08, PRO-178). `run.py verify` prints each book's debt and fails only if the count GROWS, so no book that was green went red and no new person can arrive without a link or a recorded gap. A book not listed here, and every new book, is held strictly to the 80% floor or a recorded profile.socials_gap. The checked search (`site-portfolio.py <slug> --socials-only --record-gap`) clears a book by lifting it over the floor or by recording the gap; then take it off this list. These counts are the state after the 2026-10-08 pass, in which the search engine answered almost nothing (people-search-engines); the search is still owed for every book here.
